mathTarget.parentLine: Notes next door are steps; the far low note is a hop

classes.parentPrompt: Show your child the low G outside the house, then help the thumb hop there.
classes.childAction: Tiptoe the small steps, then hop your thumb down to low G.
classes.bridge: Steps are next-door keys; the frog hop jumps far left, where sounds are low.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: small steps, a big leap, low on the left.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick notes fit in the time of one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'walk' for long notes and 'run-ning' for the two quick ones.
classes.childAction: Say walk and run-ning while your fingers play the dance line.
classes.bridge: A walking note is one big step; run-ning is two tiny mouse steps.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two quick notes in one beat.

classes.parentTip: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat and count 1, 2, 3, 4 softly.
